title: Completed PRODUCT ACCEPTANCE FORM Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed PRODUCT ACCEPTANCE FORM artifact data payloads (PMO-06.08).

id.description: Enter a unique requirement identifier from the requirements documentation.

requirement.description: Enter the requirement description from the requirements documentation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Enter the criteria for acceptance, stated so they can be judged as met or not met.

validation_method.description: Describe the method of validating that the requirement meets the stakeholder's needs.

verification_method.description: Optional. Record the verification method used to prove that the deliverable meets the requirement. Adding this column turns the form into a product verification, validation, and acceptance form.

status.description: Document whether the requirement or deliverable was accepted or not.

sign_off.description: Obtain the signature of the party accepting the product.

acceptance_date.description: Enter the date the product was accepted. This dates the acceptance for the project record and for the requirements traceability matrix.

comments.description: Add any comments relevant to the acceptance, such as conditions attached to the acceptance, or items deferred to a later acceptance.
